```{r}
inventory <- readxl::read_xlsx("FileInventoryUpdatesRyan.xlsx")

meta <- asdf[[]]
meta$barcode <- colnames(asdf)
df.samples <- as.data.frame(table(asdf$orig.ident))

adt.assay <- GetAssayData(asdf, assay = "ADT")
saveRDS(adt.assay, "~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/adt.assay.rds")

asdf@assays$ADT <- NULL
Idents(asdf) <- asdf$orig.ident

#saveRDS(asdf, "~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/asdf.all.rds")
asdf <- R2easygene::update_genes(Seurat_obj = asdf, select_assay = "RNA", return_seurat = T, min.cells = 3, min.features = 100)

colnames(asdf@assays$RNA@layers$counts) <- colnames(asdf)
rownames(asdf@assays$RNA@layers$counts) <- rownames(asdf)

meta <- merge(meta, inventory[,1:14], by.x = "orig.ident", by.y = "Sample")

barcodes <- meta$barcode
rownames(meta) <- barcodes

asdf[[]] <- meta

asdf.new <- UpdateSeuratObject(asdf)
asdf <- asdf.new

VlnPlot(asdf, features = "percent.mt", pt.size = 0, y.max = 20)
VlnPlot(asdf, features = "percent.rb", pt.size = 0)
VlnPlot(asdf, features = "nCount_RNA", pt.size = 0, y.max = 30000)
VlnPlot(asdf, features = "nFeature_RNA", pt.size = 0)
VlnPlot(asdf, features = "HBB", pt.size = 0, y.max = 500)
table(asdf$db.class)

###############################################################################
saveRDS(asdf, "~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/asdf.all.unfiltered.rds")
asdf <- readRDS("~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/asdf.all.unfiltered.rds")
###############################################################################

asdf <- subset(asdf, percent.rb < 55 & db.class == "singlet")

asdf <- NormalizeData(asdf)
asdf <- FindVariableFeatures(asdf)
asdf <- SketchData(
  object = asdf,
  ncells = 100000,
  method = "LeverageScore",
  sketched.assay = "sketch"
)

DefaultAssay(asdf) <- "sketch"

asdf <- FindVariableFeatures(asdf)
asdf <- NormalizeData(asdf)
asdf <- ScaleData(asdf)
asdf <- RunPCA(asdf, assay = "sketch")
asdf <- RunHarmony(asdf, group.by.vars = "orig.ident", 
				reduction = "pca", assay.use = "sketch", reduction.save = "harmony", ncores = 30)
asdf <- RunUMAP(asdf, dims = 1:50, return.model = T, reduction = "harmony", reduction.name = "umap.harmony")
asdf <- FindNeighbors(asdf, dims = 1:50, reduction = "harmony", assay = "sketch")
asdf <- FindClusters(asdf, resolution = c(.1,.5,1), graph.name = "sketch_nn")


##############################################################


asdf <- ProjectData(
  object = asdf,
  assay = "RNA",
  full.reduction = "pca.full",
  sketched.assay = "sketch",
  sketched.reduction = "harmony",
  umap.model = "umap.harmony",
  dims = 1:50,
  refdata = list(sketch_nn_res.0.1 = "sketch_nn_res.0.1", sketch_nn_res.0.5 = "sketch_nn_res.0.5", sketch_nn_res.1 = "sketch_nn_res.1")
)

DimPlot(asdf, label = T, label.size = 3, reduction = "full.umap.harmony", group.by = "orig.ident", alpha = 0.1) + NoLegend()
DimPlot(asdf, label = T, label.size = 3, reduction = "full.umap.harmony", group.by = "sketch_nn_res.0.1", alpha = 0.1) + NoLegend()
DimPlot(asdf, label = T, label.size = 3, reduction = "full.umap.harmony", group.by = "sketch_nn_res.0.5", alpha = 0.1) + NoLegend()
DimPlot(asdf, label = T, label.size = 3, reduction = "full.umap.harmony", group.by = "sketch_nn_res.1", alpha = 0.1) + NoLegend()

DimPlot(asdf, reduction = "full.umap.harmony", group.by = "orig.ident", alpha = 0.1, pt.size = .1, raster = F) + NoLegend()
ggsave("figs.final/int.umap.orig.ident.png", height = 5, width = 8)
```

```{r}
Idents(asdf) <- asdf$Dx
unique((Idents(asdf)))
asdf <- RenameIdents(object = asdf,
             "Mycosis fungoides" = "MF",
             "Sezary Syndrome" = "SS",
             "Healthy Control" = "HC",
             "Primary Cutaneous Anaplastic Large Cell Lymphoma" = "PCALCL",
             "Follicular Mycosis Fungoides" = "FMF")

asdf$Dx <- Idents(asdf)

asdf$has.tcr <- !is.na(asdf$cloneType)
table(asdf$has.tcr)
asdf$has.tcr <- ifelse(asdf$has.tcr == TRUE, "TCR_Detected", "No_TCR")
table(asdf$has.tcr)

asdf$hyper <- asdf$cloneType ==  "Hyperexpanded (0.1 < X <= 1)"
table(asdf$hyper)
asdf$hyper <- ifelse(asdf$hyper == TRUE, "Hyperexpanded", "Not_Hyperexpanded")
table(asdf$hyper)
asdf$tcr.and.hyper <- paste0(asdf$has.tcr, "_", asdf$hyper)
table(asdf$tcr.and.hyper)
asdf$tcr.and.hyper[asdf$tcr.and.hyper == "No_TCR_NA"] <- "No_TCR"
table(asdf$tcr.and.hyper)

table(asdf$Dx.final)

asdf$cloneType.missing <- asdf$cloneType
levels(asdf$cloneType.missing) <- c(levels(asdf$cloneType.missing), "missing")
asdf$cloneType.missing[is.na(asdf$cloneType.missing)] <- "missing"
asdf$cloneType.missing <- factor(x = asdf$cloneType.missing, levels = c("missing", "Rare (0 < X <= 1e-04)", "Small (1e-04 < X <= 0.001)", "Medium (0.001 < X <= 0.01)", "Large (0.01 < X <= 0.1)", "Hyperexpanded (0.1 < X <= 1)"))

levels(asdf$cloneType.missing)



asdf$Path.Stage.numeric <- ifelse(asdf$Path.Stage %in% c("IA", "IB", "I"), "Stage_I",
                                  ifelse(asdf$Path.Stage %in% c("IIA", "IIB", "II"), "Stage_II",
                                  ifelse(asdf$Path.Stage %in% c("IIIA", "IIIB", "III"), "Stage_III",
                                  ifelse(asdf$Path.Stage %in% c("IVA", "IVB", "IV"), "Stage_IV", "HC"))))
table(asdf$Path.Stage, asdf$Path.Stage.numeric)
asdf$Path.Stage.bin <- ifelse(asdf$Path.Stage %in% c("IA", "IB", "IIA"), "Early_Stage",
                                  ifelse(asdf$Path.Stage %in% c("IIB", "IIIA", "IIIB", "IVA", "IVB", "IV"), "Late_Stage", "HC"))
table(asdf$Path.Stage, asdf$Path.Stage.bin)


table(asdf$Sample.Type)
asdf$Sample.Type.simple <- ifelse(asdf$Sample.Type %in% c("patch", "plaque", "patch/plaque"), "patch/plaque",
                                  ifelse(asdf$Sample.Type %in% c("tumor", "nodule"), "tumor",
                                  ifelse(asdf$Sample.Type %in% c("blood"), "blood",
                                  ifelse(asdf$Sample.Type %in% c("erythroderma"), "erythroderma",
                                  ifelse(asdf$Sample.Type %in% c("HC", "nonlesional", "resolved lesion"), "HC/non_lesional",
```

```{r}
t.cells <- subset(asdf, celltype %in% c("T_Cells", "Mitotic"))
df.t.sample.hyper <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(t.cells$orig.ident, t.cells$hyper))
# Subset the cells where CTgene is "NA.NA.NA_NA.NA.NA.NA"
df.top <- as.data.frame(table(t.cells$CTgene))
check <- subset(t.cells, CTgene %in% c("NA.NA.NA_NA.NA.NA.NA","NA_NA.NA.NA.NA","NA.NA.NA_NA"))
table(check$orig.ident)
df.top <- as.data.frame(table(check$CTaa))

# Update CTgene for specific samples based on CTaa values
target_samples <- c("S31", "S32", "S33", "S34", "S35", "S36", "S37", "S38", 
                    "S39", "S40", "S41", "S42", "S43", "S44")

t.cells$CTgene[t.cells$orig.ident %in% target_samples] <- 
  t.cells$CTaa[t.cells$orig.ident %in% target_samples]

# Split CTgene into alpha and beta chains
t.cells$split.alpha <- stringr::str_split(t.cells$CTgene, "_", simplify = TRUE)[, 1]
t.cells$split.beta <- stringr::str_split(t.cells$CTgene, "_", simplify = TRUE)[, 2]

table(t.cells$cloneType)
t.cells$cloneType[t.cells$Dx == "HC" & t.cells$cloneType == "Hyperexpanded (0.1 < X <= 1)"] <- "Large (0.01 < X <= 0.1)"
table(t.cells$cloneType)


df <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(t.cells$orig.ident, t.cells$hyper))

remove <- rownames(df)[df$Hyperexpanded == 0 | df$Not_Hyperexpanded == 0]
keep <- setdiff(rownames(df), remove)
# Initialize storage for new clone assignments
ss <- subset(t.cells, cloneType == "Hyperexpanded (0.1 < X <= 1)" & orig.ident %in% keep)
  
split.alpha <- ss$split.alpha
names(split.alpha) <- ss$barcode
split.alpha <- split.alpha[split.alpha != "" & !is.na(split.alpha) & split.alpha != "NA"]
  
split.beta <- ss$split.beta
names(split.beta) <- ss$barcode
split.beta <- split.beta[split.beta != "" & !is.na(split.beta) & split.beta != "NA"]



list <- unique(ss$orig.ident)
save.new.clones <- character()

t.cells$new.clones.a <- NA
t.cells$new.clones.b <- NA
for (tmp in list) {
  # Subset the cells by orig.ident
  idx <- t.cells$orig.ident == tmp
  
  current_alpha <- t.cells$split.alpha[idx]
  current_beta <- t.cells$split.beta[idx]
  
  alpha.top <- split.alpha[names(split.alpha) %in% t.cells$barcode[idx]]
  alpha.top <- table(alpha.top)
  alpha.top <- sort(alpha.top, decreasing = TRUE)
  alpha.top <- names(alpha.top)[1]
  
  beta.top <- split.beta[names(split.beta) %in% t.cells$barcode[idx]]
  beta.top <- table(beta.top)
  beta.top <- sort(beta.top, decreasing = TRUE)
  beta.top <- names(beta.top)[1]
  
  t.cells$new.clones.a[idx] <- current_alpha %in% alpha.top
  t.cells$new.clones.b[idx] <- current_beta %in% beta.top
}

t.cells$new.clones <- ifelse(t.cells$new.clones.a | t.cells$new.clones.b, 
                             "Malignant", "Non_malignant")
t.cells$new.clones[t.cells$cloneType.missing == "missing"] <- "missing"
t.cells$new.clones[t.cells$cloneType.missing == "Hyperexpanded (0.1 < X <= 1)" & t.cells$orig.ident %in% c("S58", "S59", "S60")] <- "Malignant"
t.cells$new.clones[t.cells$CTaa == "NA_CSALGESYEQYF" & t.cells$orig.ident %in% c("S61", "S62", "S63", "S64")] <- "Malignant"
t.cells$new.clones[t.cells$CTaa == "NA_CASSLALSGGAYNEQFF" & t.cells$orig.ident == "S3"] <- "Malignant"


table(t.cells$new.clones, t.cells$orig.ident)
table(t.cells$new.clones, t.cells$tcr.and.hyper)
table(t.cells$new.clones)


idx <- t.cells$orig.ident %in% remove
table(t.cells$new.clones, t.cells$orig.ident)
t.cells$new.clones[idx]


#Read in final.clones
final.clones <- readRDS(file = "final.clones.rds")
########################



t.cells$new.clones[idx] <- final.clones[match(t.cells$barcode[idx], names(final.clones))]
table(t.cells$new.clones, t.cells$orig.ident)
t.cells$new.clones[t.cells$Dx == "HC"] <- "Non_malignant"
```
























```{r}
final.clones <- readRDS(file = "final.clones.rds")

rm(asdf.new, meta, new.obj, barcodes)
gc()
asdf$nCount_ADT <- NULL
asdf$nCount_SCT <- NULL
asdf$nFeature_ADT <- NULL
asdf$nFeature_SCT <- NULL

asdf$HPCA.pruned.labels <- stringr::word(string = asdf$HPCA.labels, sep = ":")
Idents(asdf) <- asdf$Dx
unique((Idents(asdf)))
asdf <- RenameIdents(object = asdf,
             "Mycosis fungoides" = "MF",
             "Sezary Syndrome" = "SS",
             "Healthy Control" = "HC",
             "Primary Cutaneous Anaplastic Large Cell Lymphoma" = "PCALCL",
             "Follicular Mycosis Fungoides" = "FMF")
asdf$Dx <- Idents(asdf)
Idents(asdf) <- asdf$knn.leiden
asdf$has.tcr <- !is.na(asdf$cloneType)
table(asdf$has.tcr)
asdf$hyper <- asdf$cloneType ==  "Hyperexpanded (0.1 < X <= 1)"
table(asdf$hyper)
asdf$tcr.and.hyper <- paste0(asdf$has.tcr, asdf$hyper)


table(asdf$Dx.final)
asdf$Dx.final.simple <- ifelse(asdf$Dx.final %in% c("CD4_FMF"), "CD4_FMF",
                             ifelse(asdf$Dx.final %in% c("CD4_MF"), "CD4_MF",
                             ifelse(asdf$Dx.final %in% c("CD4_PCALCL"), "CD4_PCALCL",
                             ifelse(asdf$Dx.final %in% c("CD4_SS"), "CD4_SS",
                             ifelse(asdf$Dx.final %in% c("CD8_MF", "CD8A_MF"), "CD8_MF",
                             ifelse(asdf$Dx.final %in% c("CD8A_GD_MF", "GD_MF"), "GD_CTCL",
                             ifelse(asdf$Dx.final %in% c("CD8B_PCALCL"), "CD8_PCALCL",
                             ifelse(asdf$Dx.final %in% c("CD8B_SS"), "CD8_SS",
```

```{r}
################################################################################

combine_matrices_list <- function(matrices_list) {
  
  # Step 1: Get all unique column names from all matrices
  all_colnames <- Reduce(union, lapply(matrices_list, colnames))
  
  # Step 2: Align each matrix to the full set of column names, filling missing columns with NA
  aligned_matrices <- lapply(matrices_list, function(mat) {
    missing_cols <- setdiff(all_colnames, colnames(mat))
    
    # Add missing columns filled with NAs
    if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
      mat <- cbind(mat, matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(mat), ncol = length(missing_cols),
                               dimnames = list(NULL, missing_cols)))
    }
    
    # Reorder columns to match all_colnames
    mat <- mat[, all_colnames, drop = FALSE]
    return(mat)
  })
  
  # Step 3: Combine all aligned matrices by row
  combined_matrix <- do.call(rbind, aligned_matrices)
  
  return(combined_matrix)
}
scale_matrix <- function(mat) {
  min_val <- min(mat)  # Find the minimum value
  max_val <- max(mat)  # Find the maximum value
  scaled_mat <- (mat - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)  # Apply the scaling formula
  return(scaled_mat)
}

all.matrices <- list()
list <- c("B-Cells","Endothelial","Fibroblasts","Keratinocytes","Muscle-Cells","Malignant","Myeloid","Non-Malignant")
asdf$agg <- paste0(asdf$orig.ident, asdf$celltype.malig)
df.sample.celltypes <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(asdf$celltype.malig, asdf$orig.ident))

asdf.agg <- AggregateExpression(asdf.ss, return.seurat = T, group.by = c("orig.ident", "celltype.malig"))
rm(asdf.ss)

df.counts <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(asdf$celltype.malig, asdf$orig.ident))

for(i in seq_along(list)){
  tmp <- list[i]
  ss.agg <- subset(asdf.agg, celltype.malig == tmp)
  mat.ss.agg <- ss.agg@assays$RNA@layers$data
  ss.agg <- FindVariableFeatures(ss.agg, nfeatures = 2000)
  features <- VariableFeatures(ss.agg)
  features <- setdiff(features, bad_genes)

  colnames(mat.ss.agg) <- colnames(ss.agg)
  rownames(mat.ss.agg) <- rownames(ss.agg)

  mat.ss.agg <- mat.ss.agg[rowSums(mat.ss.agg) >10,]
  mat.ss.agg <- mat.ss.agg[rownames(mat.ss.agg) %in% features,]
  mat.ss.agg.scale <- mat.ss.agg

  rownames(mat.ss.agg.scale) <- paste0(tmp, "_", rownames(mat.ss.agg.scale))

  colnames(mat.ss.agg.scale) <- str_extract(colnames(mat.ss.agg.scale), "^[^_]+")
  colnames(mat.ss.agg.scale) <- str_extract(colnames(mat.ss.agg.scale), "^[^_]+")
  
  mat.ss.agg.scale <- apply(mat.ss.agg.scale, 2, function(x) (x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x)))
  all.matrices[[i]] <- mat.ss.agg.scale
}
```

```{r}
ss <- subset(asdf, orig.ident %in% complete)
list <- unique(ss$celltype.malig)
nmf.list <- list()
for(i in seq_along(list)){
  tmp <- list[i]
  ss2 <- subset(ss, celltype.malig == tmp)
  ss2 <- FindVariableFeatures(ss2, nfeatures = 2000)
  features <- setdiff(VariableFeatures(ss2), bad_genes)
  split.ss <- SplitObject(ss2, split.by = "orig.ident")
  split.ss <- Filter(function(x) ncol(x) >= 25, split.ss)
  geneNMF.programs <- GeneNMF::multiNMF(split.ss, assay="RNA", slot="data", k=5:8, L1=c(0,0), hvg = features, scale = T, center = F)
  geneNMF.metaprograms <- GeneNMF::getMetaPrograms(geneNMF.programs,
                                        max.genes=50,
                                        hclust.method="ward.D2", 
                                        min.confidence = 0.8, 
                                        nMP = 12, 
                                        specificity.weight = 1, weight.explained = 1,
                                        metric = "jaccard")
  nmf.list[[i]] <- geneNMF.metaprograms
}
```

```{r}
inventory2$Dx <- factor(inventory2$Dx)
inventory2$cd4_cd8 <- factor(inventory2$cd4_cd8)
inventory2$Dx.final.simple <- factor(inventory2$Dx.final.simple)

inventory_count <- inventory2 %>%
  group_by(Dx, cd4_cd8, Dx.final.simple) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = 'drop')

levels(inventory_count$Dx)
inventory_count$Dx <- factor(inventory_count$Dx, 
                             levels = c("Healthy Control","Primary Cutaneous Anaplastic Large Cell Lymphoma",
                                        "Follicular Mycosis Fungoides",
                                        "Sezary Syndrome",
                                        "Mycosis fungoides"))
levels(inventory_count$cd4_cd8)
inventory_count$cd4_cd8 <- factor(inventory_count$cd4_cd8, 
                             levels = c("HC","NEGATIVE",
                                        "CD8B",
                                        "CD8A",
                                        "CD8",
                                        "CD4"
                                        ))
levels(inventory_count$Dx.final.simple)
inventory_count$Dx.final.simple <- factor(inventory_count$Dx.final.simple, 
                             levels = c("CD8_PCALCL",
                                        "CD4_PCALCL",
                                        "DN_FMF",
                                        "CD4_FMF",
                                        "CD8_SS",
                                        "CD4_SS",
                                        "GD_CTCL",
                                        "DN_MF",
                                        "CD8_MF",
                                        "CD4_MF",
                                        "HC"))


ggplot(data = inventory_count,
       aes(axis1 = Dx,       # First variable
           axis2 = cd4_cd8,  # Second variable
           axis3 = Dx.final.simple, # Third variable
           y = n)) +         # y defines the height of the flows
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = Dx.final.simple)) +      # Alluvial flows, colored by Dx.final
  geom_stratum() +                           # Strata on each axis
  geom_text(stat = "stratum",                # Labels for strata
            aes(label = after_stat(stratum))) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Dx", "CD4/CD8", "Dx.final.simple"),  # Correct axis labels
                   expand = c(0.15, 0.05)) + # Expand spacing between the axes
  theme_void()
ggsave("~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/figs/alluvial.dx.png", height = 10, width = 8)

rm(inventory2, inventory_count)
```

```{r}
  }
```

```{r}
# Convert labels to factor for classification
labels <- factor(pseudobulk_data$labels)
  
# Prepare the training data
pseudobulk_matrix <- as.data.frame(t(pseudobulk_data$pseudobulk_matrix))
  
# Split the data into training and test sets
set.seed(123)
train_idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(pseudobulk_matrix)), size = 0.8 * nrow(pseudobulk_matrix))
train_data <- pseudobulk_matrix[train_idx, ]
test_data <- pseudobulk_matrix[-train_idx, ]
train_labels <- labels[train_idx]
test_labels <- labels[-train_idx]
  
# Train a random forest model
rf_model <- randomForest(x = train_data, y = train_labels, ntree = 100)
  
# Evaluate the model
predictions <- predict(rf_model, test_data)
accuracy <- sum(predictions == test_labels) / length(test_labels)
  
cat("Model Accuracy:", accuracy, "\n")
  
return(rf_model)
```
